originalClock.scope: Thin photo-sized native edge only for whole unadjusted pictures; no image resizing/crops/motion/settings changes

verdict: Accepted bounded native whole-photo border source change; rendered pixel gates remain separate.

findings.finding: ImageView subclass draws the original image first, then an inset stroke entirely inside its source-sized view. It retains FIT_XY, bitmap, pivots, scale and translations; no extra child, padding, layout area or crop is added. Border ink is ARGB(96,222,216,203), fixed inverse-scaled one-dp width.

Visibility changes and scaleX updates while enabled invalidate the view. Density is finite/positive, capped at4 or falls back1; invalid/nonpositive scale and either displayed dimension below24dp skip drawing. Existing stage assignments set equal X/Y scales, so inverseScale keeps the edge width stable. Retained Gallery reflow and snapshot/resize transform updates repaint at their latest scale.

Admission uses actual path.whole, excludes editing and manually adjusted photos, with the intentional normal Gallery Spread exception because that mode ignores saved crops and retains whole-photo plans. Fill paths admitted as cropped have whole=false. A manual adjustment is excluded even when zoom1/whole.

Entering editing rebuilds a border-disabled view before in-place manual updates. Finish/save/cancel rebuilds the correct normal scene and restores retained transforms. ImageView superclass casts/bitmap identity checks still accept the subclass. Cleanup removes the view/bitmap references as before; new view owns only one small Paint and no timers or external resources.

Replacing only the subclass constructor and removing the two admission lines restores the complete captured stage. All geometry, matte, bitmap budget, child ownership/count, crop/edit mechanics, pause/seek, resize, dissolve/timers and stop methods remain byte-identical.

reviewedConditions.wholeUnadjusted: enabled when not editing; actual draw also requires at least24dp in each displayed dimension
reviewedConditions.gallerySpreadSavedAdjustment: enabled outside editing because normal spread ignores that saved crop

limits: Source inspection/normalization only; reviewer performed no source/test writes, builds, device/network/Git actions.
Native seven-capture fixture must separately prove visible literal border blend, retained corners/geometry/matte/admission/opacity and tiny/manual negative controls.

No native compositor/GPU performance, live motion/dissolve, FaceRenderer or complete controller integration, owner photos, optimized/API28 or malformed/nonuniform external view-transform behavior is claimed.
